name: NIST Gaithersburg — Ground Array
notes: Measured telemetry. NREL PVDAQ system 4902 via the OEDI data lake. 1152 Sharp NU-U235F2 modules, fixed ground mount, PV Powered PVP 260kW inverter. On-site pyranometer and weather station.

name: NIST Gaithersburg — Parking Canopy
notes: Measured telemetry. NREL PVDAQ system 4901 via the OEDI data lake. 1032 Sharp NU-U235F2 modules on a dual east/west canopy (azimuth 90 and 270); the registry records the east mount only, so physics-model output is approximate for this site.

name: NIST Gaithersburg — Building Roof
notes: Measured telemetry. NREL PVDAQ system 4903 via the OEDI data lake. 312 Sharp NU-U235F2 modules, low-tilt roof mount, Satcon PVS-75 inverter.
